scripts.dev: concurrently -k -s first -n web,main,preload,electron "pnpm --dir ../web run dev" "pnpm run dev:bundle:main" "pnpm run dev:bundle:preload" "pnpm run dev:electron"
scripts.dev:bundle: concurrently -k -s first -n main,preload "pnpm run dev:bundle:main" "pnpm run dev:bundle:preload"
scripts.dev:electron: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 dist/main/index.cjs dist/preload/preload.cjs && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE LENSFLARE_DESKTOP_DEV=1 electronmon .
scripts.build: pnpm run build:bundle && env -u ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE electron-builder
scripts.build:bundle: vp pack src/main/index.ts --out-dir dist/main && vp pack src/preload.ts --out-dir dist/preload
